How to survive

  1. You are the band. Each lane is a part: drums, melody, bass, chords. Every gem is a real note of the song.
  2. Miss and that part drops out of the music until you hit its lane again. Misses cost health; early or wrong taps are free.
  3. Win the room before the music stops. Pick a relic, pick a door.
